description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure Azure Blob Storage as the grain storage in an Orleans silo. It provides methods to set Azure Blob Storage as default or named storage with optional configuration options.

classes.name: AzureBlobSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Azure Blob Storage for Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage as the default grain storage, with options to specify configuration via an action.

methods.name: AddAzureBlobGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Blob Storage for grain storage with a specified name and optional configuration.
